title: PROJ-42: any employee can propose an idea to the backlog
environment: web as a second dev user with the backlogEdit flag forced off, to act as an employee outside the product team.

claims.text: A match that is in progress shows "In progress" and has no vote option.

items.shows: The second match carries an "In progress" label and no "Vote for this instead" button; the backlog match below it has one.
items.how: As the non-team user on /backlog: Propose an idea, title "Dark mode for the dashboard", submit, wait for "Is it one of these?".

claims.text: If the duplicate check fails, an error is recorded in telemetry with the failure reason.

items.shows: The backlog.duplicate_check span ends with error status and carries the failure reason.
items.how: Setup for this claim: the duplicate check's service call forced to answer 500. Proposed "Idea while the check is forced to fail", then read the web app's exported span.

claims.text: When an idea is posted, #product-ideas receives a chat message with its title, proposer and a link to it.

items.shows: Posting an idea hands the notification service one notice with the title, the proposer's name and a link to the item.
items.how: Posted "Export the dashboard as PDF" and read the web-to-notifier request.

items.reason: No chat bot token locally, so the notifier answers not-configured. To close it: post one idea where PROPOSALS_CHANNEL_ID is set and the bot is in the channel.
